name: search.grep observes cancel between files and inside large files

source.note: Minimized from TOOL-01: search.grep checks CancellationToken between files and every 256 lines inside a file, returning hits already found. Standalone scanner with AtomicBool; no workspace/tokio.

description: scan(files, needle, cancel) must walk each (path, body) pair and collect matching lines. If cancel trips, return the hits already found plus cancelled=true instead of finishing the remaining files. Check the token at the start of every file and every 8 lines inside a file so a large file can stop mid-scan. The seed ignores cancel and always reports a complete scan. Keep line numbers 1-based. Do not drop hits collected before the token trips.
